title: outreach-send
description: Proactive outreach send request (docs/design/proactive-outreach.md §3.1, owner decision P1; outreach slice 4): the parameters of the governed Action nexloop.outreach.send:1 and the request the server freezes from them. The caller never chooses the topic, the purpose version, the origin kind or the business intent id: the server derives them (topic and version from the current purpose list; intent id = sha256 of tenant, consumer, purpose, origin_ref and the day in the tenant time zone). Every dispatch gate is rechecked at dispatch; the Action is external and its real dispatch switch is closed by default.

purpose.description: A purpose of the current outreach purpose list, enabled for the tenant.

origin_ref.description: What the send follows from: a commitment, a receipt intent, a plan or the owner's own request.

body.description: The message text; the purpose's content_rules.max_chars also applies.

channel.description: v1: the native WebChat channel only.

conversation_id.description: Optional (P4): continue this conversation of the consumer; otherwise the server chooses.

frozen.description: Server-derived, never accepted from the caller.
